thread:
incident-bot: 🔔 Pager: Elevated 5xx and gateway timeouts observed for /v1/generate. Alerting on-call for infra-prod. Severity: P1.

kevin: ack I'm on call, looking. Where's the spike from?

maria: metrics show 5xx from edge LB -> gateway cluster. Error type: 502/504 + a bunch of upstream-reset. Top source: gw-prod-eu region.

kevin: checking Envoy stats now, tailing logs. `kubectl -n infra logs svc/gateway-proxy -f` shows a lot of retrying in the proxy: `upstream_rq_per_host` jump.

ash: @kevin saw a rollout earlier this morning that adjusted a retry policy on the gateway route (increase attempts from 1 to 3) and lowered the circuit_breaker max_connections on some backend pool.

kevin: that combination smells like a retry amplification/cascade. If retries + lowered capacity -> queueing -> more timeouts -> more retries.

chloe: customer impact: support queue spiking, ~7% of generation requests getting 5xx in last 12m per Datadog. Some timeouts for low-latency customers.

kevin: quick mitigation plan: 1) disable client-side retries at gateway (set retry policy to 0) 2) rollback circuit_breaker change or raise thresholds 3) route small % to warm pool (if available) 4) update status page. Doing 1 now.

maria: rolling `gw-route-config` to set `retry_policy: none` for the route `POST /v1/generate` on gw-prod-eu. Patch below:

```yaml
# PATCH /envoy/routes/gw-route-config
- retry_policy:
+ retry_policy: null
```

deploy-bot: deploy started for gw-route-config (canary: gw-prod-eu). Job id: deploy-20241201-0301.

kevin: canary applied, monitoring error rate. Watching 5xx % on the canary host.

(3 minutes pass)

maria: canary shows drop from 12% -> 4% on the host where retries disabled. Global roll starting.

kevin: rolling rollback of circuit_breaker tweak as well: increasing `max_connections` back to previous value. Command: `kubectl apply -f cb-backfill.yaml -n infra`

chloe: support-engineer: posting initial status update to customers: "We are investigating increased errors for the generation API. Mitigation in progress; no data loss reported."

kevin: after disabling retries and restoring CBs, global 5xx dropped to ~1.1% within 8 minutes. Latency stabilized.

ash: root cause hypothesis: policy change earlier increased retry attempts while an unrelated CB tighten reduced allowed connections. Together caused transient capacity collapse and retry amplification.

anya: who approved the retry policy change? We need to capture rollout metadata for postmortem.

maria: change was part of morning gateway rollout (cherry-picked config PR #4228), owner @ash (linked in deploy notes).

ash: confirming I pushed PR to increase retries to help with occasional backend flakiness, didn't realize CB adjustments shipped in the same window — they were separate. Bad timing.

kevin: action items (quick):
- ash: open revert PR audit + notes on why retries were increased (owner)
- maria: add canary/metric guard for retry policy changes to runbook (prevent global roll without 15m canary)
- chloe/support-engineer: sent update to affected customers and set watch for escalations
- anya: schedule postmortem once incident is stable

chloe: support-engineer: impacted customers list attached to ticket - ~28 customers saw >=1 5xx, 3 on paid tiers reported failures. I've prioritized callbacks for top 3.

deploy-bot: canary rollout for retry disable: success. Global rollout complete.

kevin: handing off to anya for extended monitoring & post-incident cleanup. Summary for next shift: root cause likely retry+CB interaction; mitigated by disabling retries + restoring CB thresholds; watch for reoccurrence if retries reintroduced without traffic caps. Current status: degraded -> recovered.

anya: taking over. I'll keep the watch for 2 hours and then move to postmortem. Please add any notes/observations to the incident ticket (INC-2024-8742).

maria: logging: saved histogram dumps, Envoy admin /stats snapshots, and the canary vs global comparison graphs to INC-2024-8742.

chloe: updated status page: "Partial outage affecting generation API (resolved). Root cause under investigation. Customers who experienced errors may retry requests; we recommend retries with exponential backoff on client side for now."

kevin: thumbs: :thumbsup: good job team. Quick follow-ups: add automated guard to block retry increases and CB reductions in same deploy window; consider an integration test that simulates retry amplification.

anya: noted. I'll own the follow-ups. Closing on-call handoff: thanks everyone.

support-engineer: I'll follow up with impacted customers with timeline and mitigation steps.

incident-bot: Incident closed by anya at 1720000600. Postmortem requested: INC-2024-8742.
